title: Hearty Crispy Portuguese Chicken Bake
description: A savory and crispy Portuguese dish featuring poppy seeds, perfect for a sick day, with anti-inflammatory friendly ingredients. This wood-fired bake is a hearty and comforting meal.
instructions: Preheat the wood-fired oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, turmeric, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken thighs to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and arrange the chicken thighs on it.
Sprinkle the poppy seeds over the chicken thighs.
Slice the onion and potatoes, and arrange them around the chicken thighs on the baking sheet.
Bake the chicken and vegetables in the preheated oven for 45 minutes.
Increase the oven temperature to 475 degrees Fahrenheit and continue baking for an additional 20 minutes, or until the chicken is crispy and golden brown.
Remove the baking sheet from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes before serving.
